choice: 1440 docked workbench; <=1180 evidence wing becomes tethered drawer sheet; <=820 left wing becomes drawer, composer sticky-bottom, wing meta translates to footnotes; <=480 spine becomes sticky top strip, drawers stack, prose stays at body size with 12px gutters.
rationale: Satisfies 375-1440px hard floor with no page h-scroll while keeping the composer persistently reachable.
Tethered drawers preserve cite-back context that a generic tab bar would lose.
Footnote translation keeps verification metadata reachable without a docked wing.
alternatives: Squeeze all three panes at every width
risks: Drawer stacking order and sticky offsets interact; z-order and sticky rules are specified to remove invention.
revisitWhen: If real-device testing shows sticky composer plus strip-spine consume too much vertical space at 375px.
